import { requireInteger, requireRecord, requireString } from '../validation/inputGuards';
import type { AddProductCommand } from './ProductDtos';

export function parseAddProductCommand(input: unknown): AddProductCommand {
  const body = requireRecord(input, 'Product');
  return {
    id: requireString(body, 'id'),
    name: requireString(body, 'name'),
    priceCents: requireInteger(body, 'priceCents'),
    initialStock: requireInteger(body, 'initialStock'),
  };
}
